definitions.explanation: Physical shrinking or wasting away, especially of muscles or organs due to lack of use or disease.

definitions.gloss: being intimidated; shrinking back; feeling overwhelmed
definitions.explanation: Psychological state of feeling intimidated or overwhelmed, causing one to hold back or become timid.

examples.japanese: ⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{萎縮|いしゅく}⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦リハビリ→リハビリ：11192_rihabiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Do rehabilitation to prevent muscle atrophy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{萎縮|いしゅく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{懸念|けねん}される→懸念する：22508_kenensuru⟧。
examples.english: There are concerns about market contraction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長期|ちょうき}→長期：03487_chouki⟧⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{萎縮|いしゅく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{萎縮|いしゅく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまう。
examples.english: I feel intimidated in front of my boss.

examples.japanese: {萎縮|いしゅく}せず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}おう→言う：00515_iu⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{萎縮|いしゅく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The employees have become intimidated after receiving harsh criticism.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{萎|い} (wither, shrink) + {縮|しゅく} (shrink, contract)
Both characters relate to becoming smaller.

MEDICAL CONTEXT:
- {筋|きん}{萎縮|いしゅく} - muscle atrophy
- ⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧{萎縮|いしゅく} - brain atrophy
- ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧{萎縮|いしゅく} - gastric atrophy

PSYCHOLOGICAL CONTEXT:
- {萎縮|いしゅく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまう - to become intimidated
- {萎縮|いしゅく}せず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - without being intimidated
- {萎縮|いしゅく}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ - chilling effect

ECONOMIC CONTEXT:
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{萎縮|いしゅく} - economic contraction
- ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{萎縮|いしゅく} - market shrinkage

NOTE ON READINGS:
{萎縮|いしゅく} is the standard reading. The word may also be seen as {委縮|いしゅく} with a different first kanji.
